60% (Quad) |time = 30:00 |rewards = {{Coins|2,000}}, {{Gem|45}}, {{Exp|300}} & {{TowerExp|195}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|For a frosty experience.|Gamemode Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Frost''' mode is one of the six main survival modes. '''Frost''' mode has 40 waves. It is named after snow and frost-themed enemies in said mode. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. The health of enemies in this mode scales with the player count, starting at two players. The increase 30% in duo, 45% in trio and 60% in quad. It is applied after attributes, like [[Bloated]], meaning they can affect the health of an enemy. The increase is not always the stated amount. ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Some maps like [[Mason Arch]] can also increase all rewards by a specific amount. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !Gem Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|800}} ÷ (1 + [(40 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^2.4) + {{Coins|1,200}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Gem|45}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|200}} ÷ (1 + [(40 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^2) + {{Exp|100}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{TowerExp|85}} ÷ (1 + [(40 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|110}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Frost''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. [[Beach Crate]], [[Scuba Ops Crate]] and [[Patriotic Crate]] are also part of this, though it is not known which rarity they are in. These items are: *{{Color|Common}} (31.25%) **{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}} (2-4) **{{ReviveTicket|Revive Ticket}} (2-3) **{{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}} (2-3) **[[Low Grade Crate]] **[[Barricade]] (2-4) **[[Supply Drop]] (2-4) **[[Easter Egg]] (2-4) *{{Color|Uncommon}} (26.79%) **[[Cooldown Flag]] (2-4) **[[Range Flag]] (2-4) **[[Damage Flag]] (2-4) **[[Mid Grade Crate]] **[[Ducky Squad]] (2-4) *{{Color|Rare}} (26.79%) **[[High Grade Crate]] **[[Napalm Strike]] (2-3) **[[Blizzard Bomb]] (2-3) *{{Color|Epic}} (13.39%) **TBA *{{Color|Legendary}} (1.79%) **[[Nuke]] **[[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] **[[Holy Hand Grenade]] ===Badges/Achievements=== There are [[badges]] and achievements that you can or could obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside them. These are: {{Badge |title = Defeat the Frost Spirit |description = Defeat the Frost Spirit in Frost Mode. |image = FrostModeBadge.png |obtainable = Yes }} {{Badge |title = Licensed Technician |description = Triumph Frost Mode with [[Spotlight Tech]]. |image = Achievement |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Coins|500}}, 1x {{SpinTicket|Spin Ticket}}, 1x {{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Ticket}}, 1x [[Showtime Crate]] }} ===Seasons=== During some [[Passes]], the '''Frost''' mode could give currency rewards that you used to progress through a season. Between waves 1 to 30, the wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|325}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|80}})^1.03 Between waves 31 and 40, it is calculated as: :{{Money|325}} + ([Waves Completed - 1] × {{Money|80}})^1.07 Depending on player count, the wave bonus is reduced using multipliers. These multipliers are: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Players !Reduction per Player !Total Reduction |- |Solo |0% |0% |- |Duo |15% |30% |- |Trio |13% |39% |- |Quad |10% |40% |} The wave clear bonus appears when every enemy from that wave was killed and no damage was dealt to the base health. It is 7.5% of the wave bonus in solo, while for duo, trio and quad it is 5%. The waves in '''Frost''' mode follow these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="width:50%; margin:1em auto" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-5 |0:30 |0:10Skip at 0:20. |- |6-24 |0:50 |0:16Skip at 0:34. |- |25 |2:00 |0:40Skip at 1:20. |- |26-28 |1:50 |0:36Skip at 1:14. |- |29 |1:00 |0:20Skip at 0:40. |- |30-31 |1:50 |0:36 |- |32 |1:30 |0:30Skip at 1:00. |- |33 |3:00 |1:00Skip at 2:00. |- |34 |1:30 |0:30 |- |35 |2:30 |0:50Skip at 1:40. |- |36 |1:30 |0:30 |- |37 |2:00 |0:40 |- |38 |2:30 |0:50 |- |39 |2:00 |0:40 |- |40 |∞ |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut. The total of enemies in '''Frost''' Mode excluding summoned enemies is 821 enemies. Number includes summons from the naturally spawned [[Frostbane]], [[Frost Mystery]] and [[Mega Frost Mystery]] as while a lot of them summon in a random enemy from a list, they will always spawn a specific number of enemies on death, making them consistent. Other forms of summoning are not accounted due to them being inconsistent.
